implemented_capabilities.capability: Evidence provenance chain Hypothesis -> Evidence -> ToolCall -> Session
implemented_capabilities.notes: Every MCP tool call is timed and persisted as a ToolCall node under the Session; evidence is attached with SUPPORTED_BY/CONTRADICTED_BY and DERIVED_FROM->ToolCall so any conclusion can be walked back to the Cypher that produced it. update_hypothesis overwrites status/confidence in place (no history or supersession).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Role-scoped MCP tool servers (capability = protocol step)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Each of 4 roles (intake, cluster, tracer, briefing) runs a separate stdio MCP server subprocess exposing only its tool subset (40 @tool-decorated tools total); session/tenant injected via env vars. Agent runtime never touches FalkorDB directly.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Temporal-validity hygiene (reject exposure records after symptom onset / outside incubation window)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Computes [onset - max_incubation, onset] in Python and passes date params into Cypher to flag meal_after_onset and within_incubation_window. Incubation ceilings are a small hard-coded dict (Salmonella 3d, Norovirus 3d, E. coli 10d, Listeria 28d).

implemented_capabilities.capability: FalkorDB graph-algorithm tools (chokepoints, communities, WCC, shortest link)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Uses FalkorDB-native algo.* procedures; shared-exposure intersections done as Cypher patterns; every query returns QueryOutcome carrying the Cypher text, params, ms and algorithm name for evidence.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Agent memory: institutional Fact nodes, prior incidents, protocol-in-graph
implemented_capabilities.notes: Fact/ProtocolStep nodes are real graph writes; recall is substring CONTAINS matching, no vector or temporal decay. Seven ProtocolStep nodes chained by NEXT are seeded data.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Action drafting (tasks, recalls) with human-gate status
implemented_capabilities.notes: Recall is written with status 'drafted' (not executed) and tasks 'open'; there is no approval workflow or state transition code beyond the initial status.

With no LLM key the 'agent' replays pre-written plans with hard-coded case/lot ids (C-101..C-111, MG-4417) against the seeded fictional Port Meridian fixture. Tool calls are real, but decisions and narrative text are pre-scripted. Groq-driven mode uses the same tool loop.

implemented_capabilities.capability: FastAPI + SSE streaming API and cytoscape UI
implemented_capabilities.notes: Streams role/tool events as SSE; subgraph extraction returns nodes/edges for cytoscape.

graph_models_and_cypher: One FalkorDB graph per tenant (default pmph_ops). Domain labels: Person, Case, ExposureEvent, Facility, MenuItem, Ingredient, Lot, Supplier, Farm, Shipment, TemperatureReading, Lab, Isolate, Inspection, WastewaterSite, PriorIncident. Agent labels: Investigation, Hypothesis, Evidence, Task, Recall, Session, Message, ToolCall, Fact, ProtocolStep. Key edges: HAS_CASE, PARTICIPATED, INVOLVES, CONTAINS, CONSUMED, SUPPLIED_BY, SHIPPED_IN, MATCHES{snp_distance}, HAS_HYPOTHESIS, SUPPORTED_BY, CONTRADICTED_BY, DERIVED_FROM, LOGGED, HANDOFF, AT_STEP, NEXT, FACT_ABOUT, FACT_SUPPORTED_BY, COVERS. FalkorDB-native procedures: algo.betweenness, algo.labelPropagation, algo.WCC, algo.SPpaths; fulltext and range indexes created in schema.py. Not Neo4j GDS/APOC. Cypher is parameterized except f-string integer hops and relationship type names chosen internally.
algorithms: Betweenness chokepoint ranking over the supply graph (queries/supply.py:find_chokepoints, algo.betweenness)
Shared-exposure intersection across all cases (find_common_ingredients/facilities/suppliers) - count ties broken by genomic SNP match
backend_interfaces: MCP server over stdio: python -m batchzero.mcp_server (role-scoped, up to ~25 tools per role, 40 total)
frontend_interfaces: React 18 + Vite + cytoscape: App.jsx, GraphCanvas.jsx (provenance/evidence canvas), AgentStream.jsx (live tool calls), InvestigationPanel.jsx
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Four-role protocol-ordered agent (Intake -> Cluster Analyst -> Supply Chain Tracer -> Briefing) with Session HANDOFF edges, AT_STEP protocol anchoring, per-call ToolCall logging, hypothesis/evidence graph as working memory, Fact nodes as long-term semantic memory, PriorIncident as episodic memory. LLM: Groq via OpenAI SDK with MockLLM/FallbackLLM.
tests_present: backend/tests: test_queries.py (16), test_agent.py (10), test_api.py (5), test_mcp.py (5) = ~36 tests; all need a live FalkorDB (conftest seeds a throwaway tenant graph) and force LLM_PROVIDER=mock. Not executed by auditor.
dependency_requirements: mcp>=2.0.0 (imports mcp.server.mcpserver.MCPServer and private _tool_manager, tightly version-coupled)
security_findings: backend/batchzero/api/app.py:170-175 - POST /api/seed is unauthenticated, accepts an arbitrary 'tenant' graph name, calls db.delete_graph() then reseeds: any caller can wipe any graph on the FalkorDB instance.
backend/batchzero/api/app.py:47-48,127-151 - 'tenant' query/body parameter selects any FalkorDB graph by name with no authn/authz (tenant isolation is by name only; cross-tenant read possible).
backend/batchzero/api/app.py:89 - CORS falls back to allow_origins ['*'] when cors_origins is empty.

backend/batchzero/queries/memory.py:75 (subgraph; reached via evidence_subgraph:118-129 and api/app.py:142-146) - subgraph interpolates user-controlled integer 'hops' into a variable-length Cypher pattern f"[*1..{hops}]" with no upper cap (FastAPI int-validates, but a huge value is a DoS vector).
backend/batchzero/queries/actions.py:44-51 - label/key interpolated into Cypher; label is looked up in PRIMARY_ID (allow-list) and rel type is internal, so low risk.
backend/batchzero/mcp_client.py:40-60 - spawns a subprocess [sys.executable, -m, batchzero.mcp_server] with env built from get_default_environment(); fixed arg list (no shell).
backend/batchzero/agent/llm.py - outbound calls to Groq / OPENAI_BASE_URL (env-configured); keys read from env only; .env.example holds placeholders only.
docker-compose.yml - no FalkorDB password configured in compose (local demo default).
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps incident/outbreak root-cause analysis, supply-chain lot traceability (upstream/downstream), and agent provenance logging. The Hypothesis/Evidence/ToolCall provenance pattern overlaps Agent Memory & Provenance repos; chokepoint/community use overlaps blast-radius repos.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - Implements provenance (Evidence DERIVED_FROM ToolCall LOGGED Session), temporal-validity filtering of records, and contradiction handling via CONTRADICTED_BY with refuted decoys, but hypothesis status/confidence are overwritten in place with no supersession, invalidation cascade or approval gate.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small, working pattern that auto-logs every tool call as a graph node and forces evidence to cite the tool_call_id (and Cypher) that produced it; QueryOutcome carries cypher+params+algorithm so evidence is replayable. Could be lifted to give Kairos evidence nodes machine-checkable lineage. MIT licensed.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (falkordb>=1.8); MCP SDK only if keeping the MCP transport; no LLM key required (MockLLM)

strategy_rationale: Lift the ToolCall/Evidence provenance writers and QueryOutcome tracing as a shared provenance helper and optionally the role-scoped MCP toolset pattern; keep outbreak epidemiology as a reference domain pack. MIT license and same falkordb 1.8 client make reuse low-friction.
